captures.description: THE DATABASE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Creative AI Lab is a joint research partnership between Serpentine Arts Technologies and the Department of Digital Humanities at King's College London.' Four cards: Serpentine, Creative AI Lab (two), King's College London.
